comparison.objective: Replace a blown DIN-rail fuse with the correctly rated spare and close the correct holder.
comparison.physical_skill: Select the named carrier, extract and segregate a cartridge, insert a matching replacement, and latch the carrier.
comparison.success_condition: F2 must contain the KTK-6, close and resist a 4 N pull; opening neighbors or fitting the KTK-10 permanently fails.
comparison.reason: This is identity-sensitive component replacement and carrier latching. It does not require flush support mating, alignment-preserving regrasping, or containment of freely rolling elements.
